boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 86 is a fast, compact puzzle on a C-shaped board. A wide red block spans the top, a green block with padlock `3` sits in the center-left, orange and blue blocks fill the middle, and a tall purple column runs down the right side. Unlock the green padlock by clearing three blocks first (blue, orange, red), then feed the purple column through the bottom exits.
landmarks: Block Out Level 86 is a fast, compact puzzle on a C-shaped board.
A wide red block spans the top, a green block with padlock `3` sits in the center-left, orange and blue blocks fill the middle, and a tall purple column runs down the right side.
Unlock the green padlock by clearing three blocks first (blue, orange, red), then feed the purple column through the bottom exits.

quickTips: Clear the blue, orange, and red blocks first (in that order) to unlock the green padlock `3` by move three.
The purple column on the right needs the bottom row empty — clear yellow blocks before feeding it.
This level is only 39 seconds — every move counts, plan the first three clears before starting.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Push the small blue block in the center upward through the top exit — this is the first clear toward the green padlock (02:57 in the video).

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Slide the orange key block left through the left-wall exit — second clear, and it removes the key gate (02:55).

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Push the wide red block at the top upward through the top exit — third clear, unlocking the green padlock `3` (02:52).

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Clear the unlocked green block through the left-wall exit because it now has room to slide left (02:49).

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Clear the yellow blocks at the bottom through the down-arrow exits to open the lane for the purple column (02:46).

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Feed the tall purple column on the right downward through the bottom exits — it is the largest mass and takes several passes (02:43–02:34).

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish with the remaining small green blocks at the bottom (02:31–02:25).

failurePoints: Trying to move the green padlock `3` block before clearing three other blocks — it is locked and will not budge, wasting a move on a 39-second timer.
Leaving yellow blocks at the bottom while feeding the purple column — the column cannot pass through and stalls mid-feed.
